verdict.rationale: Metronome documents sending sandbox and production data directly to your data warehouse. Paginated list endpoints and a published OpenAPI spec also allow programmatic bulk extraction, so the core of exporting data is covered. However, the evidence never states which formats are used, whether 'all' data is included, or how offboarding works. Missing for 10: explicit open-format export (e.g. CSV/Parquet), confirmation that the export covers all data, documented account-exit/offboarding process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
